text_block_list.text:
One day, Nice Nature and I travel to
Kyushu to
prepare for the Kokura Kinen
and check out the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The course is pretty unique. I'm guessing
that
pacing will be key to winning.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Me too.
choice_data_list: 実際に見に来てよかったな
実際に見に来てよかったね

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, I did wonder why we would
come all the
way down here just to see
the track at first.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: But I actually did learn something, and I got to eat tasty food to boot. I'd call that a good day.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmm... We pretty much saw everything.
choice_data_list: 他に見たいところはある？

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And by the way, you don't have to cater
to me so
much!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I know we're mainly here to see the
track, but...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
This trip is also supposed to cheer me
up, right?
You know... since I was a
little... down after my
last race.

Nice Nature recently competed against
Tokai
Teio. She did well, but she's still
feeling down due
to a lack of
confidence.

So, like she said, I brought her to
Kyushu for a
change of pace and to get
her spirits up. I guess
she's seen right
through me.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
My good sense of perception comes
from my
mom, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
More like I wasn't even feeling that low
to begin
with. You worry too much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It was Teio I was competing against. The

difference in our star quality was too
much from
the start!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: There's no way I'd feel THAT low.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I wouldn't forget my place that bad.

She says that, but I still sense a hint of
frustration
behind her words.

What can make her feel more confident?
Is there
anything I can do?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Captain! Shopping district, ho! Just
look at
those signs!
Shopping district... Come to think of it...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But all the same... they cheer for me no
matter
what.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Like, who would do that? Cheer for me?! It's funny, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: They care about me sooo much.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
And I get reeeeally motivated when they
cheer
me on.
...That's it!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: W-wait up, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I've noticed that all shopping districts
have very
similar vibes.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In terms of liveliness, though, I'd say this
one is a
whole lot more vibrant.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Uh, do I sound like some sort of
shopping district
connoisseur? It's not
like that, really.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Well, I wouldn't say no to a detour!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's see if any of these shops
meet my
high standards!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at that fresh fish! The scales
are so
shiny!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hmph, not too shabby. I didn't know fish like this could be found in an ordinary shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fish Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, miss! You've got a good eye
for fish!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Darn right I do! I'm known for it back
home.

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fish Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that something! Then, let me test
ya!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fish Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Which would you choose? The squid on
the right
or the one on the left?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Obviously, I'd choose the left one! The
brightness
of the eyes are so different.

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fish Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Okay, you win! I can't believe such an
amazing
young lady came here!

text_block_list.name: Kokura Fish Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
The squid is yours. Why don't ya have it
cooked
at the restaurant in the back?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Do you really mean it?! Thank you,
thank youuu!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
How lucky, hehe! ♪ I can't pass up such
a kind
offer!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer!

After that, we continue to visit shops,
and Nice
Nature has fun interacting with
the people in the
shopping district.

Her expression grows softer and softer
as the day
goes on, and then...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun! Everyone was so
frank and
energetic. I guess that's
Kyushu for ya!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They were so funny too, don'tcha
think? ♪ Hm, I
think I might have
accidentally picked up a fake
accent
from all this.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, they did.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's been a while since I laughed so hard
and had
such a blast with people.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The truth is, I haven't been able to visit
Kimie and
the others recently.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...I didn't feel like I could smile naturally.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is happy for me, no matter how
I do.
They smile and tell me I did a great
job.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But by myself, I feel so lost. I can't help
but
wonder if I really did my best.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I mean, with first place, it's easy to tell,
right?
You get a trophy, or in the case of
the Tenno
Sho, a shield-like plaque.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Those trophies are proof you've done
your best,
but you only get that with
first place.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So I appreciate the shopping district's

unconditional acceptance of me, but... it
doesn't
always feel like it's enough.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
But now... I guess I'm realizing how much
it means
to me to hear people call out
my name.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, this is so frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Today's going exactly as you planned it.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I confess... I feel so refreshed!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Can't make any excuses about my
fatigue getting
in the way of my
performance now, can I?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, you can't say that! That's too
much
pressure!
choice_data_list: じゃあ、結果を出していこうか

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That really took a toll on me—I'm totally
drained.
I'm a sensitive soul, after all...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I'm just joking! Hehehe...

As I thought, the people who support
Nice Nature
are what gives her energy.

Today's events will surely fuel her
success in the
Kokura Kinen.
